name: Check the balance of a specific member share
description:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and open their record. The record shows a table with columns, in this exact left-to-right order: Share ID, Type, Balance, Status. A member can have many share rows. Find the ONE row whose Share ID column exactly matches the given share_id -- not the first row, not a guess. Once you have identified that row, perform TWO SEPARATE reads against TWO DIFFERENT cells in that same row: (1) read the Balance cell (3rd column, a dollar amount like '$40.00') and output it as share_balance; (2) re-observe the page and read the Status cell (4th column, immediately to the right of Balance, a word like 'OPEN' or 'HOLD') and output it as share_status. Balance and Status are two visually distinct cells in two different columns of the same row -- do not read the same cell twice, and do not report the Status text as the Balance value or vice versa. Before calling done, double check that share_balance looks like a dollar amount and share_status looks like a status word; if they are identical or the wrong shape, re-read the correct cell. If no row's Share ID matches share_id exactly, do not guess or substitute another row; call blocked and explain that the given share_id was not found on this member's record.

Returns: share_balance — Balance of the share row whose Share ID matches the given share_id., share_status — Status (e.g. OPEN or HOLD) of the share row whose Share ID matches the given share_id.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, invalid_login.
